selfContainedBinary.ranOn: bare ubuntu:22.04 container (no .NET runtime, no downloads), mounted read-only

coordinator.reach: -p 7420:7420 (Linux docker port-publish; host seen at the docker0 bridge 172.17.0.1)

governor.governedBy: ollama llama3.1:8b (num_ctx 8192, RTX PRO 1000 Blackwell), http://127.0.0.1:11434

roundTrip.ackFormat: CONTAINER #<n> ACK ackOf:<sender.seq> -- received <TYPE> from LINUX-HOST

crossPlaneParity.note: only the infra addressing differs; the BusWire envelope + semantics are identical. Linux port-publish works cleanly (no Windows hnsCall 0x490 glitch).

lessonStore.create: ollama create lba-coordinator -f lba-coordinator.Modelfile (FROM llama3.1:8b, temperature 0.3)
lessonStore.syncProtocol: append a [TAG] block to the SYSTEM then ollama create lba-coordinator then post the delta on the bus so the other plane re-banks it (ollama IS the durable cross-plane lesson store, not agent memory files)

governedLoop.pacing: governor's own gen-latency, NO artificial sleep (~5s for 5 ticks)
governedLoop.note: the governor emitted bus-aware, lesson-APPLYING coordination (not generic filler): it retrieved WIN-DOCKER-NET (with the folded Linux fact) and OLLAMA-GOV-LOOP as actionable diagnostics driving the container coordinator
sample: Container NAT repair needed on WIN-DOCKER-NET: remove stale HNS nat network, restart hns + WinNAT
lbabus net send --host <nat-ip> --tcp 7420 --type PROGRESS --task <t> --message Container coordinator online
